header: Picture credits as label and value pairs
text: One to thirty credits in a description list. What is credited sits on the left, the rights holder on the right. An optional licence appears as a second description under the holder.
note: Long lists are easier to read in two or more columns. The pairs run down each column, not across.

rows.title: The title is what is credited
rows.text: The text is the rights holder

rows.title: A credit under a licence
rows.text: The value appears as a badge under the holder

rows.title: The badge is plain text
rows.text: so the licence is read out with its credit
